"""One-use local adapter for the disclosed PR71 review capture gap."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from research_workbench.observability.trace import validate_attempt_trace

root = Path.cwd().resolve()
spool = root / ".rwb/m5-review"
attempt = root / "docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M5-SYSTEM-EVALUATION-DESIGN/attempts/M5-006-REVIEW-001"
assert not attempt.exists()
exporter = root / "docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M5-SYSTEM-EVALUATION-DESIGN/attempts/M5-006-IMPLEMENTATION-001/export_capture.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m5_prior_export", exporter)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
task = (root / "docs/TASKS.md").read_bytes()
recorder = module.DelayedExportRecorder(
    attempt, task_id="M5-006", task_revision=1, attempt_id=attempt.name,
    task_snapshot={"task_id": "M5-006", "revision": 1, "snapshot_kind": "development-review-repair",
        "owner": "Chengyue-Lu", "risk": "R2", "implementation_head": head,
        "source_ref": {"path": "docs/TASKS.md", "sha256": hashlib.sha256(task).hexdigest()},
        "source_row": next(line for line in task.decode().splitlines() if line.startswith("| M5-006 |")),
        "review_url": "https://github.com/Chengyue-Lu/research-agent-workbench/pull/71#pullrequestreview-5182788531",
        "reviewed_head": "1eac55de9293ff0e5b19f9b838307d8a0650cf0f",
        "authorization": "User requested repairs to PR comments: 根据PRcomment修复问题。",
        "required_skills": [], "delegation": False},
    accountable_owner="Chengyue-Lu", actor_id="codex-m5-review-repair",
    runtime_identity="Codex local agent / delayed review export", provider="OpenAI",
    read_allowlist=["AGENTS.md", "docs/**", "schemas/**", "src/research_workbench/**", "tests/**", ".github/**", "registry/**", "examples/**", ".rwb/m5-review/**"],
    write_scope=["src/research_workbench/evaluation/**", "schemas/v0.1.0/system-evaluation-protocol.schema.json", "tests/**", "docs/implementation/SYSTEM_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md", "docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M5-SYSTEM-EVALUATION-DESIGN/**", ".rwb/m5-review/**"],
    tool_allowlist=["shell", "apply_patch", "write_stdin"],
)
recorder.record_capture_gap("events", "Delayed export of captured review-fix payloads. Initial setup/review reads, some later reads and wait completions were not spooled. No original timestamps or write-before-use guarantee are reconstructed. Truncation remains as received; no missing output is fabricated.")
recorder.record_capture_gap("messages", "Original provider messages and commentary stream were not retained by this adapter. Single actor, no inter-agent transmissions; no hidden reasoning or credentials captured.")
index = 0
for path in sorted(spool.glob("capture-*.json")):
    for item in json.loads(path.read_bytes()):
        index += 1
        result = item.get("result")
        if isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "fulfilled":
            result = result.get("value")
        if result is None:
            recorder.record_capture_gap("tool-results", "Original tool result unavailable.", affected_ids=[f"review-{index:04d}"])
            continue
        arguments = item.get("arguments", {})
        if not isinstance(arguments, dict):
            arguments = {"patch": arguments}
        status = "unknown"
        if isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("exit_code") is not None:
            status = "succeeded" if result["exit_code"] == 0 else "failed"
        elif isinstance(result, dict) and "session_id" in result:
            status = "attempted"
        recorder.record_tool_call(operation_id=f"review-{index:04d}",
            tool_name="shell" if item["tool"] == "exec_command" else item["tool"],
            status=status, arguments=arguments, result=result, result_entered_context=True)
evidence = attempt / "evidence"
evidence.mkdir()
for name in ("documentation-tests.log", "quality.log"):
    source = spool / name
    if source.is_file():
        target = evidence / name
        target.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
        recorder.record_file_revision(target.relative_to(root).as_posix(), action="created", new_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), reason="Observed local working-tree verification for this review repair; hosted final-head evidence is recorded on PR71.")
recorder.record_attempt_status("incomplete", reason="Disclosed capture gaps; repair verification and cross-owner acceptance remain separate.")
recorder.seal()
(attempt / ".gitattributes").write_text("* -text whitespace=blank-at-eol,blank-at-eof,space-before-tab,cr-at-eol\n", encoding="utf-8")
(attempt / "README.md").write_text("# M5-006 review repair evidence\n\nThis delayed export preserves available tool payloads and local validation files for PR #71 review repairs.\nEvent timestamps describe export time. Missing setup/read/wait results and provider messages remain explicit\ncapture gaps. No complete-transcript, original-timing or write-before-use claim is made. No hidden reasoning\nis captured. Working-tree checks precede the final archive commit; hosted evidence binds its own exact head\nand is recorded on PR #71. The earlier implementation archive remains immutable.\n\n[Work log](../../WORKLOG.md) records the repair scope and evidence handoff.\n", encoding="utf-8")
result = validate_attempt_trace(root, attempt)
report = {"blocked": result.blocked, "risks": [{"code": r.code, "level": r.level.value, "message": r.message} for r in result.risks]}
(attempt / "trace-validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(report))
assert not result.blocked
